### REQ-021: Enable OTA rollback (app rollback + pending-verify actually active)

- **Status:** DONE
- **Added:** 2026-07-02
- **Completed:** 2026-07-04
- **Verified by:** code review + idf.py fullclean build 2026-07-04 (rollback enabled in sdkconfig, image 1.14 MB fits 1536K OTA slots; on-device rollback test pending, no board attached)
- **Depends on:** –
- **Description:**

`OtaManager::validateBootIfNeeded()` (`net/ota_manager.cpp:271-286`) implements the pending-verify / cancel-rollback flow, but `CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE` is **not set** in `espidf/sdkconfig`, so `esp_ota_get_state_partition()` never reports `ESP_OTA_IMG_PENDING_VERIFY` — the function is dead code and there is **no rollback**: an OTA image that boots but misbehaves boot-loops until manually reflashed, on remote devices whose update path is OTA.

Fix:
1. Enable `CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE` in `sdkconfig.defaults` (and regenerate `sdkconfig`).
2. Decouple boot validation from MQTT: currently it only runs when WiFi **and** MQTT connect within their 10 s boot timeouts (`main.cpp:527-533`). A new image should self-validate on a broader health criterion (e.g. app_main reached + tasks created + optionally WiFi association), otherwise a broker outage at boot rolls back a good image on next reset.
3. Verify partition sizes still fit with rollback enabled (otadata already present in `partitions.csv`).

See finding F-9 in `doc/reports/2026-07-02_migration_code_review.md`.

- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - [ ] After OTA, `esp_ota_get_state_partition()` returns `PENDING_VERIFY` on first boot and the app marks itself valid — *pending, no board attached 2026-07-04*
  - [ ] A deliberately crashing test image (abort in app_main) rolls back to the previous image automatically — *pending, no board attached 2026-07-04*
  - [x] Validation succeeds with the MQTT broker offline (validateBootIfNeeded() moved after createTasks(), unconditional — code inspection)
  - [x] `doc/OTA_Usage.md` updated with the rollback behavior
- **Notes:** Also fix the CLAUDE.md flash command: it passes `--flash_size 2MB` while sdkconfig/partitions target 8 MB — following it corrupts the OTA layout (report §6, doc drift).
